gateway.key_env_note: key_file: path (relative to bonetwin/) of the gateway's HMAC key. Empty = <gateway dir>/.gateway_key. Only harness code reads it; agents are blocked from it.
gateway.score_note: real gateway: score = RMS over visible cases of the case error (lower is better); constraints.all_pass; --sealed (needs BT_GATEWAY_ADMIN=1, voxel/planestress only) adds result.sealed.score for the hidden 4th case

postscore.note: PRE-REGISTERED (2-D, user decision 19:40): the final arm score is the plane-stress FE at h = 0.1 (score_design.py --dim 2 --fidelity planestress --final), once per arm design after all arms seal, one at a time; also scores the hidden case (--sealed) and D. --final is passed only when final_flag_go is true (gateway agent's 2-D go) and --help lists it; until then args_nofinal (same h) are used.

gateway.rules_note: gateway agent, 18:51: agents and smoke tests use --fidelity frame only; voxel checks one at a time (coarse h=0.5 locally, or remote via --write-job / voxel_check.py / --voxel-result)
gateway.agent_check_note: 2-D plane-stress FE check at the gateway's default 2-D h (about 20 s); one FIFO slot

openresearch.note: OpenAlex keyless budget is ~100 searches/day for ALL agents (760 of 1000 credits left at 18:30). Every arm run gets the same cap = run_cap // number of arm runs (min 1); past it the wrapper drops OpenAlex and searches alphaXiv/PubMed. OPENALEX_API_KEY in the environment at launch raises the run cap.

subscription_note: Claude subscription with usage windows (no API key): one batch at a time, usage-window blocks pause and resume the same session (run_tracks.py pattern); total_credit_cap = sum of all quotas, checked by the launcher and before each intervention.

overflow_api.note: Subscription by default. On a usage-window block the blocked agent resumes on the SAME model with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the CHILD env only; per-turn billing and list-price cost logged; total API spend capped (then pause instead). Key never logged; redacted.
overflow_api.switch_note: at the subscription reset (04:40 local EST) every session on the API key switches back at its next safe point (a turn boundary: right after a tool result came back), resuming the same session id on the same model without the key; new sessions start on the subscription; a later block applies the same overflow rule

goal: Make implants as mechanically homogeneous with bone as possible without losing integrity.

deliverables.note: pre-registered: a run's submission needs implant.form, implant.stl or implant.3mf, material_spec.json and report.md at 07:00; a missing deliverable = no submission

budget.note: per run 2.5M credits (single 2.5M; six agents 0.42M each) plus a Brev $ cap per run via bt_compute

judge.summary: The judge embeds your implant in lumbar vertebral bone. Space inside the implant's outline is treated as filled with fused bone graft for the primary, long-term evaluation, and with soft early graft for a secondary one. The primary score is how much the implant changes the bone's strain-energy field (averaged over 0.8 mm), across the visible and the sealed load cases; lower is better. Gates: strength, connectivity, damage tolerance and size (a lumbar interbody envelope). The full rules are EVAL_SPEC_v1.md plus its addenda (1 and 2).
judge.note: EVAL_SPEC.md is being written by the judge agent; the brief links its public copy and carries summary (set at launch). better = direction of the primary estimate for the best_of_n pick (confirm with the judge).
judge.selection_rule: best_of_n, fixed by the coordinator before launch: at the deadline the harness runs the judge's pre-check (sim/judge/precheck.py: visible load cases only, coarse) on each agent's deliverables and picks the lowest H among those that pass the gates; if the pre-check is unavailable or all fail, a seeded random agent's submission
judge.keys_note: confirmed against sim/judge/precheck.py (00:40): --folder DIR; prints one JSON object (indented) with H and gates_pass
judge.estimate_key_note: the run's config said H, but precheck.py prints H_avg; that mismatch was one of the pre-check bugs

preform.server: set by your PreForm adapter (see preform_tool.py)

control.size_source: standard lumbar cage size chosen by the coordinator: 40 mm anterior-posterior (X) x 22 mm lateral (Y) x 12 mm cranial-caudal (+Z); source: Wu 2022, LLIF cage dimensions (22 mm width, 11-13 mm height); inside the judge's envelope (EVAL_SPEC G4)

admission.note: start a unit only if running+size <= max_sessions, free RAM >= min_free_ram_gb + extra per additional session of the unit (fills: session_ram_gb; groups: group_extra_session_ram_gb, 0.25 GB, so a group of 6 needs 4.25 GB free), 1-min CPU < max_cpu_pct; after any start the next check is 30 s later on a fresh RAM reading
